content.user_title: Create Slash Commands for AI Workflows
content.value_statement: Repeated AI workflows are slow when users rely on long natural language prompts. This skill helps define concise slash commands with routing, validation, chaining, and help text.
actual_capabilities: Designs slash command names using consistent verb-noun and model-prefix patterns.
Defines command parameters, required inputs, flags, options, and validation rules.
Maps commands to skills, cascades, agents, or model-specific routes.
Describes chaining patterns for sequential, parallel, conditional, and multi-model workflows.
Generates command catalog, help text, and completion guidance for discovered skills.
Shows integration patterns for Claude Code command registration.
limitations: It is a documentation skill and does not install a working CLI by itself.
Generated commands depend on accurate metadata from installed skills and agents.
Users must review generated commands before adding them to shared environments.
It does not enforce runtime permissions or sandbox policy for routed tools.

use_cases.title: Create Team Command Shortcuts
use_cases.description: Turn repeated AI tasks into named slash commands with clear inputs, defaults, and help text.

use_cases.title: Catalog Installed Skills
use_cases.description: Organize available skills, cascades, and agents into a searchable command catalog.

use_cases.title: Design Multi-Model Workflows
use_cases.description: Route research, implementation, review, and audit tasks across Claude, Codex, and other model tools.

prompt_templates.title: Create One Command
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner task for a single repeated workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a slash command for my repeated task. Include the command name, required input, optional flags, and short help text.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Small Catalog
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate task for several related skills.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a command catalog for these skills. Group commands by purpose and define parameters, examples, and routing targets.

prompt_templates.title: Add Validation and Help
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate task for safer command use.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design slash commands with parameter validation, completion hints, defaults, and error messages for invalid inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Compose an Advanced Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced task for chained AI workflows.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a chained slash command workflow that routes tasks across skills, agents, and models. Include stages, inputs, outputs, and failure handling.

output_examples.input: Create commands for data extraction, validation, and report generation.
output_examples.output: A grouped command plan with names, purpose, required inputs, optional flags, routing targets, and user-facing help text.

output_examples.input: Create a command catalog for installed audit and review skills.
output_examples.output: A command catalog that separates audit, review, routing, and workflow commands with concise descriptions for each entry.

output_examples.input: Design a multi-model workflow for research, implementation, and review.
output_examples.output: A staged workflow description that assigns each phase to a suitable model or agent and explains how outputs pass between phases.

best_practices: Use short command names that follow a consistent verb-noun pattern.
Define required inputs, defaults, and validation before adding workflow chaining.
Review generated routing and permissions before sharing commands with a team.
anti_patterns: Do not create commands for rare tasks that need open-ended discussion.
Do not hide destructive actions behind short command names.
Do not route sensitive files to tools without explicit user approval.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates slash command designs, command catalogs, routing plans, validation rules, and help text for AI workflows.

faq.question: Does it execute commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides command definitions and workflow patterns. Users must implement or register commands separately.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes Claude Code command registration and discovery patterns.

faq.question: Can it route work to Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It can design commands that route selected tasks to Codex when the user has that tool available.

faq.question: What should I review before using generated commands?
faq.answer: Review file access, model routing, defaults, destructive actions, and any command that touches shared systems.

faq.question: Who is the skill best for?
faq.answer: It is best for advanced AI users and teams that repeat structured workflows often.
